description: This Java class parses XML feeds from stackoverflow.com, extracting feed entries with their titles, links, and summaries.

classes.name: StackOverflowXmlParser
classes.description: A parser class for processing XML feeds from StackOverflow, returning a list of entries.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a single post entry in the XML feed with title, link, and summary.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an InputStream containing XML data and returns a list of Entry objects.

methods.name: readFeed
methods.description: Reads the <feed> element and its child <entry> elements from the XML parser.

methods.name: readEntry
methods.description: Parses a single <entry> element and extracts its title, link, and summary.

methods.name: readTitle
methods.description: Extracts text content from a <title> tag.

methods.name: readLink
methods.description: Extracts the href attribute from a <link> element, especially when rel='alternate'.

methods.name: readSummary
methods.description: Extracts text content from a <summary> tag.

methods.name: readText
methods.description: Reads and returns the text content within the current XML element.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Skips the current XML element, handling nested elements properly.
